messages:
ravi: Heads-up: Primeway cutover dry-run scheduled tomorrow 11:00 PT. Preflight checklist: final KMS key ARN, cross-account IAM role name + trust policy, SIEM ingest URL, egress ACLs, internal DNS entries. Need everything by 18:00 PT today. @primeway-sre

deploy-bot: reminder: Dry-run job queued for 2026-03-23T18:00:00Z -> job-id dj-7751. Will post status updates.

primeway-sre: KMS ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999888777:key/pmw-3a2b. Cross-account role: RedwoodAccess_Primeway. SIEM ingest: https://logs.primeway.corp/ingest/api-key. Egress ACLs (outbound): 10.5.0.0/16 -> 15.100.200.0/24:443, 10.5.2.0/24 -> 44.55.66.0/24:443.

avery: quick note: during the staging test we hit split-horizon DNS - internal resolver returned old IP for redwood API. Please add internal A: redwood-api.private.primeway.local -> 10.5.2.14 and ensure TTL=60 so we can swap during cutover.

sofia: audit logs question: are we streaming to s3://primeway-redwood-logs? Recommend object lock = disabled so lifecycle can delete older logs per retention. Customer has a 90d retention requirement. Can primeway confirm object lock & bucket policy? :clipboard:

primeway-sre: confirm bucket = s3://primeway-redwood-logs. Object lock currently ON (legacy). We will disable object lock and add lifecycle rule 90d, will confirm when completed. Also note: KMS key scheduled rotation next Wed; we plan to rotate after cutover but can hold if Redwood needs key-stability during the switch.

ravi: thanks. One more ask - paste the IAM trust policy we should see on RedwoodAccess_Primeway (we need to validate sts:AssumeRole principal and external ID). Example below to match our deploy role:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::555666777:role/redwood-deploy"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"sts:ExternalId": "primeway-external-123"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

primeway-sre: pasted trust policy matches except ExternalId will be primeway-external-456 (customer requested different value). We'll update policy and share. Also adding alias redwood-fallback to KMS for emergency decrypt if rotation conflicts. Heads-up: if rotation happens during cutover we'll switch to alias/redwood-fallback. :rotating_light:

sofia: renewal flag: Primeway is month 10 of trial. If cutover finishes with <=1 Pager incident we'll trigger sales for renewal discussion with Dedicated discount. tagging @sales. :label:renewal

ravi: ops smoke test after dry-run please. Use this health check and post full output:
`curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://redwood-api.private.primeway.local/healthz | jq .`

primeway-sre: will run smoke tests and paste results here after dry-run. If anything fails we'll open an incident and coordinate rollback. :heavy_check_mark:

deploy-bot: dry-run started at 2026-03-23T18:00:12Z (dj-7751). Notifying channel on completion.

primeway-sre: post-dry-run result: all checks green except a 503 on /v1/generate when KV cache miss simulated. We retried and it recovered; filing ticket PMW-389 to tune cache warmup. Posting logs snippet:

```
[2026-03-23T18:02:05Z] ERROR 503 /v1/generate - kvcache: miss, fallback retried
[2026-03-23T18:02:06Z] INFO 200 /v1/generate - retried ok
```

sofia: thanks, logging PMW-389 as potential renewal risk if it recurs. ops to add to runbook.

ravi: excellent work everyone. Leaving this thread open for final bucket/object-lock confirmation and IAM policy ARN. Once confirmed we'll schedule the actual cutover. :rocket:"
